'''Climbing spikes''' were tools that helped the user ascend or descend sheer surfaces and rough terrain.<ref name="MMF" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] wore pairs of climbing spikes on his [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="IBF"/> Molecular climbing spikes were used by [[Loag]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="PGV3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> Another variant consisted of multi-spiked handles which would be alternately pushed into the wall while the other was used to reach higher. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]<ref name="MMF Date">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Murder Most Foul]]'' to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ry-Kooda]] used this type of climbing spikes to scale the wall of [[Orko]] the [[H'uun]]'s [[Orko's palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="MMF"/>

==Behind the scenes==
Climbing spikes first appeared in the article "Introducing: Boba Fett" which was published in the [[Bantha Tracks 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Bantha Tracks (department)|Bantha Tracks]]'' newsletter in [[July]] [[1979]]. A diagram within detailed the gadgets and weaponry of the new character Boba Fett, including his climbing spikes.<ref name="IBF"/>
